pc.notes: Tree Chopper v2 is built in: real axe durability -- the axe you are holding wears like you chopped every log yourself, Unbreaking counts, and it can break mid-tree and stop the felling. Leaves now vanish with the tree and still roll their sapling, stick, and apple chances.

phone.notes: The update install is fixed. Downloads now show on screen with a progress bar as they come in, and when one finishes, a big green Install update button stays on the home screen until you tap it -- no more losing a downloaded update or going back to the website. The first time, Android may ask you to allow Addon Adder under Install unknown apps; that's the setting that was silently blocking the installer before. (This version itself still arrives the old way -- the fixed flow proves itself on the next update after this one.)
